item.title: Macron’s two-day Armenia visit to spotlight EPC and EU Ties
item.description: (Horizon Weekly / YEREVAN) – French President Emmanuel Macron is set to travel to Armenia in May for a two-day official visit, according to an announcement by Armenia’s Honorary Consul in France, Denis Djorkaeff. Macron is expected to arrive in Yerevan on May 4, where he will hold talks with Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan. item.title: Ամենայն Հայոց Կաթողիկոսը ընդունեց ՀՅԴ պատուիրակութիւնը
